fields.text: !FDC 6/4012 ZOB OH..AIRSPACE LAKEPORT, OH..TEMPORARY FLIGHT RESTRICTIONS. PURSUANT TO 49 USC 40103(B)(3), THE FAA CLASSIFIES THE AIRSPACE DEFINED IN THIS NOTAM AS 'NATIONAL DEFENSE AIRSPACE'. WI AN AREA DEFINED AS 3NM RADIUS OF 412823N0814252W SFC-2999FT AGL EFFECTIVE 2610261600 UTC UNTIL 2610262300 UTC. NO UNMANNED AIRCRAFT OPS PERMITTED UNLESS AUTHORIZED BY ATC OR WAIVER. 2610261600-2610262300

tfr.reason: Stadium event: Lakeport Ironclads home game at Lakeport Stadium (seating capacity 67,000)
restrictions: No aircraft, including unmanned aircraft (UAS/drones), may operate within the area unless authorized by ATC or holding an FAA waiver.
Aircraft operating under an approved FAA waiver must squawk an assigned beacon code and remain in two-way radio contact with ATC.
Violators may be intercepted, detained and interviewed by law enforcement; UAS may be subject to detection and mitigation.
